title: add RAG agent examples, tool-calling quickstarts, and docs site updates
author: Sofia Ramirez
description: Summary: Adds a set of RAG templates, agent/tool-calling examples, and corresponding quickstarts to the docs site and examples folder. Motivation: make it easy for developers to get started with retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) patterns using Redwood's agent and tool-calling features. This PR contains:  - RAG templates for FAQ and conversational retrieval flows  - Agent examples demonstrating tool-calling (search, knowledge-base lookup, external API) in Python and TypeScript  - Quickstart guides for docs site with copy-and-paste snippets and runnable examples  - Small website navigation and sidebar updates to surface the new quickstarts  - Minor updates to SDK examples to show the new agent helper utilities  Context: Engineers and solution builders have asked for canonical RAG patterns and working agent examples to reduce onboarding friction. These examples are intended to be canonical reference material for product demos and internal enablement. Checklist:  - [x] Add RAG templates and README for each example  - [x] Add Python + TypeScript agent examples with mock tool adapters  - [x] Docs quickstarts with step-by-step run instructions and environment variable guidance  - [x] Website sidebar and TOC entries  - [x] CI/linting fixes and editorial pass Notes:  - Some examples use a small in-repo mock search adapter (examples are explicitly non-production).  - API keys and credentials instructions are intentionally high-level with links to existing auth docs.  - Follow-up task ENG-14703 tracks adding e2e tests for the quickstarts.
